name: field-build

name: field-render-local

name: field-render
command: node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e "import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, rmSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'; const pre = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--experimental-strip-types', 'tools/fieldPreflight.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (pre.status !== 0) process.exit(pre.status ?? 1); const captures = ['candy-world.png', 'rounded-scenery.png', 'rounded-scenery-normals.png', 'rounded-scenery-vertex.png', 'penguin.png', 'mechanisms-a.png', 'mechanisms-b.png']; for (const name of [...captures, 'report.json']) rmSync('out/field-shading/' + name, { force: true }); const run = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--experimental-strip-types', 'tools/chromeCheck.ts', 'fieldShading', '--out', 'out/field-shading'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (run.status !== 0) process.exit(run.status ?? 1); const report = JSON.parse(readFileSync('out/field-shading/report.json', 'utf8')); if (report.json?.ok !== true) throw new Error('field-render: report is not successful'); const missing = captures.filter(name => !report.json.captures?.includes(name) || !existsSync('out/field-shading/' + name) || statSync('out/field-shading/' + name).size === 0); if (missing.length) throw new Error('field-render: missing, empty or refused captures in out/field-shading/: ' + missing.join(', ')); mkdirSync('proofs/field-shading', { recursive: true }); copyFileSync('out/field-shading/report.json', 'proofs/field-shading/field-shading.json');"

name: field-judge-world
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" out/field-shading/candy-world.png --description "a complete candy world of Royal Fiesta with smooth shaded surfaces: every candy building, platform and decoration is present with complete geometry, curved candy shapes have continuous smooth lighting with no faceting, colour boundaries between candy materials are clean, and there are no black, inverted or dark-streaked surfaces" --min-score 6

name: field-judge-scenery
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" out/field-shading/rounded-scenery.png --description "a close view of rounded candy scenery in Royal Fiesta: complete rounded shapes with continuous smooth lighting across their curves, clean soft boundaries between candy colours, no faceted colour patches and no dark streaks" --min-score 6

name: field-judge-penguin
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" out/field-shading/penguin.png --description "a close view of a cartoon penguin in a walking or emoting pose wearing cosmetics: its rounded body and the cosmetics are complete and smoothly lit, the boundaries between black, white and orange and the cosmetic colours are clean, with no dark streaks, faceted patches or inverted lighting" --min-score 6

name: field-judge-penguin-local

name: field-judge-mechanisms-a

name: field-judge-mechanisms-b

name: field-mechanisms-diagnostics
command: node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e "import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const run = args => { const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--experimental-strip-types', ...args], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (r.status !== 0) process.exit(r.status ?? 1); }; run(['tools/fieldPreflight.ts']); for (const [name, search] of [['normals', '?normalsDebug'], ['vertex', '?normals=vertex']]) { const dir = 'out/field-shading-diagnostics/' + name; mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }); const input = dir + '/input.json'; writeFileSync(input, JSON.stringify({ search })); run(['tools/chromeCheck.ts', 'fieldShading', '--input', input, '--out', dir]); }"

name: panel-judge

name: settings-render
command: node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e "import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; import { existsSync, readFileSync, rmSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'; const captures = ['audio.png', 'graphics.png', 'controls.png', 'gameplay.png', 'phone-audio.png', 'phone-graphics.png', 'phone-controls.png', 'phone-gameplay.png', 'pause-controls.png']; for (const name of [...captures, 'report.json']) rmSync('out/settings-pages/' + name, { force: true }); const run = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--experimental-strip-types', 'tools/chromeCheck.ts', 'settingsPages', '--out', 'out/settings-pages'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (run.status !== 0) process.exit(run.status ?? 1); const report = JSON.parse(readFileSync('out/settings-pages/report.json', 'utf8')); if (report.json?.ok !== true) throw new Error('settings-render: report is not successful'); const missing = captures.filter(name => !report.json.captures?.includes(name) || !existsSync('out/settings-pages/' + name) || statSync('out/settings-pages/' + name).size === 0); if (missing.length) throw new Error('settings-render: missing, empty or unlisted captures in out/settings-pages/: ' + missing.join(', '));"
